supplemental_undersides.selection: Per building, prefer a newly found underside with the largest overlap improvement, then the least-overlapping miss, then the strongest retained match. No scored underside is a separate status.

focus_rule: Prefer changed scored matches, especially undersides, then overlap changes of at least ten points. Otherwise retain the previous overhang review focus.
